note: The /bank screen: bank accounts, statement import, reconciliation and suggested matches. No live feed (PSD2/AISP) is built yet - import reads the file a person exports from their own bank: CAMT.053, MT940 or the bank's CSV (api.bank.statement_formats, ADR-084, ADR-091).

bank.empty_body.nl: Voeg een bankrekening toe en importeer een bankafschrift om transacties te verwerken.
bank.empty_body.en: Add a bank account and import a statement to process transactions.

bank.offset_account_choose.note: Placeholder of the offset-account picker; nothing is preselected so nothing is booked to a guessed account.

bank.import_hint.note: ADR-091: the formats the import reads, as a person finds them in their bank's export menu.
bank.import_hint.nl: Download een afschrift in uw internetbankieren en kies het hier. LEDGR leest CAMT.053 (aanbevolen), MT940 en de CSV-export van ING, Rabobank, bunq, Knab en ABN AMRO. Een afschrift dat al eerder is ingelezen, wordt niet dubbel geboekt.
bank.import_hint.en: Download a statement from your online banking and choose it here. LEDGR reads CAMT.053 (recommended), MT940 and the CSV export of ING, Rabobank, bunq, Knab and ABN AMRO. A statement imported before is not booked twice.

bank.no_transactions_body.nl: Importeer een bankafschrift om transacties te zien.
bank.no_transactions_body.en: Import a bank statement to see transactions.

bank.generic_reconcile_hint.nl: Geen van deze? Kies een tegenrekening om deze transactie rechtstreeks te boeken.
bank.generic_reconcile_hint.en: None of these? Choose an offset account to post this transaction directly.

bank.suggestion.note: The best open sales invoice for an incoming bank line (ADR-091). {reference} is the invoice number, {party} the customer.

bank.suggestion_expense.note: The receipt an outgoing bank line paid (ADR-092). {party} is the supplier, {date} the receipt's date.

bank.confidence.high.note: Certain enough to be matched in bulk: the invoice number is in the payment, or the payer's name matches and no other invoice has this amount.

bank.reason.only_candidate.nl: enige open factuur of bon van dit bedrag
bank.reason.only_candidate.en: only open invoice or receipt of this amount

bank.reason.ambiguous.nl: past ook bij een andere factuur of betaling
bank.reason.ambiguous.en: also fits another invoice or payment

bank.certain_banner.note: Above the bank lines when some have a certain match (ADR-091).

nl.one: {count} betaling past zeker bij een factuur of bon.
nl.other: {count} betalingen passen zeker bij een factuur of bon.

en.one: {count} payment certainly matches an invoice or receipt.
en.other: {count} payments certainly match an invoice or receipt.

bank.match_certain_partial.note: Some certain matches were refused, e.g. the invoice was paid meanwhile; those lines stay for a person.

nl.one: {count} betaling gekoppeld; {failed} niet gelukt, bekijk die zelf.
nl.other: {count} betalingen gekoppeld; {failed} niet gelukt, bekijk die zelf.

en.one: {count} payment matched; {failed} failed, please review those yourself.
en.other: {count} payments matched; {failed} failed, please review those yourself.
